::: {.callout-note}
Detailed programme to follow.
:::

A one-day practical course on **ecoFAST** (dynamical Footprint Analysis, Shapes and Trends of ecological time series), an R package for detecting abrupt shifts and
quantifying resilience in ecological data. The morning introduces the principles of the methods
and the afternoon is devoted to hands-on practice.

Places are limited, and participants are selected on the basis of a short motivation statement:
[apply for the tutorial](https://dynshift2027-tutorial.sciencesconf.org).

## Instructors

Alejandro Cano, Mathieu Pélissié, Vasilis Dakos

## References

- Cano AV, Jensen OP, Dakos V (2025) Identifying fish populations prone to abrupt shifts via
  dynamical footprint analysis. *Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences* 122:
  e2505461122. <https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2505461122>
- Pélissié M, Devictor V, Jensen OP, Dakos V (2026) Abrupt declines in fish productivity often
  precede stock collapses in marine fisheries. *Science Advances* 12: eaed7911.
  <https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.aed7911>
